title: Sabeelen Lagate Hain
body:
Mahe Aza Mein Hum Jo Sabeele’n Lagate Hain
Karbobala ke payase hume Yaad Aate Hain
<<DIVIDER>>
Payaso’n Ko Jab Sabeel Pe Paani Pilate Hain
Karbobala Ke Payase Hume Yaad Aate Hain
<<DIVIDER>>
(1)
Mahe Aza Ka Chand Falak Par Jab Aagaya
Tayyar Humne Apni Sabeelo’n Ko Kar Diya
Phir Nazr Dene Ke Liye Jab Hath Uthate Hain
Karbobala Ke Payase Hume Yaad Aate Hain
<<DIVIDER>>
(2)
Ye Bhi To Unki yaad Mein Aansu Bahayenge
Ho Kar Bade Sabeel Pe Paani Pilayenge
Baccho’n Ko Apne Isliye Saqqa Banate Hain
Karbobala Ke Payase Hume Yaad Aate Hain
<<DIVIDER>>
(3)
Wo Teen Roze Jisko Na Paani diya gaya
6 Maah ke jis Bacche ka cheda Gaya gala
Hum Dastaan uski Jaha’n Ko Batate Hain
Karbobala Ke Payase Hume Yaad Aate Hain
<<DIVIDER>>
(4)
Karbobala ke Ban Mein nawasa Rasool ka
Mara Gaya Tha Run Mein Nawasa Rasool ka
Paani pila pila ke ye noha sunate hain
Karbobala Ke Payase Hume Yaad Aate Hain
<<DIVIDER>>
(5)
Abbas-e-Naamdaar Ke shane Qalam hue
Mashke sakeena chid gayi Paani na la sake
Hum isliye sabeel pe purcham lagate hain
Karbobala Ke Payase Hume Yaad Aate Hain
<<DIVIDER>>
(6)
Bali sakeena apne bhare ghar ki ladli
Us phool jaisi Bacchi Ko Paani mila nahi
Ye jab bhi souch lete hain Aansu Bahate hain
Karbobala Ke Payase Hume Yaad Aate Hain
<<DIVIDER>>
(7)
Ho Bhuke or Payase to Aao Sabeel par
Paani bhi pi lo khana bhi Khao sabeel par
Naam e Husain par Jo hum khana khilate hain
Karbobala Ke Payase Hume Yaad Aate Hain
<<DIVIDER>>
(8)
Zahid ye dars karbala deti hai Aaj Bhi
Mahfooz Aaye Payasa nazar Jab kabhi koi
Paani pila do payase ko maula sikhate hain
Karbobala Ke Payase Hume Yaad Aate Hain
author: Zahid Ali Chitorvi
